newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Philips names Eustace new Vice-Chairman.
newsitem.headline: Philips names Eustace new Vice-Chairman.

text.p: Philips Electronics said on Friday it had appointed Dudley Eustace to the new post of Vice-Chairman of the Company's Board of Management.
The 60 year-old Eustace, currently Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and Executive Vice-President, will take up his post on March 21.
"It is the intention that all the regional organisations of the company will report to Mr Eustace as of July 1," Philips said in a statement.
Jan Hommen, CFO and Executive Vice-President of the Aluminium Company of America (Alcoa), will fill the vacated CFO and Executive Vice-President position from April 1.
The management board is involved in the day-to-day running of the company.
